overview_description: List, create, read, update and delete the custom forms in your Exsited settings.
intro: Custom forms set the layout of the forms used for records such as accounts. This area has 5 endpoints to list, create, read, update and delete them, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **A create needs `name` and `setting_group`.** `setting_group` is a setting group name such as `ACCOUNT`, and both go under `custom_form`.
**A custom form id starts with `cf_`.** One form comes back under `custom_form`.
**Only a form that is not system generated can be deleted.** `is_system_template` tells you which forms are system generated.
**An update changes the name, display name, description or users.** Send only the fields to change under `custom_form`.
**The listing pages by cursor.** Pass `limit`, then the `next_cursor` from `pagination` as `cursor` while `has_more` is true.

endpoints.title: List custom forms
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of the custom forms in your settings.
endpoints.description: Lists the custom forms with each one's name, status and whether it is a system or default template. Records are under `data` and paging details under `pagination`. Fields filter as `filter_<field>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by, such as `created_on`, or `-created_on` for newest first.

200.description: One page of custom forms, under `data`.

endpoints.title: Create a custom form
endpoints.summary: Creates a custom form and returns it, under `custom_form`.
endpoints.description: Creates a new custom form. Send `name` and `setting_group`, a setting group name such as `ACCOUNT`, under `custom_form`. The new form comes back with its `cf_` id.

setting_group.description: The setting group the form belongs to, such as `ACCOUNT`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a custom form
endpoints.description: Reads a single custom form by its `cf_` id, with its name, display name, description and template flags.

parameters.name: custom_form_id
parameters.description: The custom form's `id`, which starts with `cf_`.

404.description: No custom form has that `id`, for example because it is deleted.

endpoints.title: Delete a custom form
endpoints.summary: Deletes a custom form that is not system generated and returns no body.
endpoints.description: Removes the custom form with this `cf_` id. Only a form that is not system generated can be deleted. A successful call returns 204 with an empty body, and reading the form afterwards returns 404.

parameters.name: custom_form_id
parameters.description: The custom form's `id`, which starts with `cf_`.

204.description: The custom form is deleted. No body.

endpoints.title: Update a custom form
endpoints.summary: Changes a custom form's name, display name, description or users and returns the form.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `custom_form`. You can change `name`, `display_name`, `description` and `users`. The updated form comes back under `custom_form`.

parameters.name: custom_form_id
parameters.description: The custom form's `id`, which starts with `cf_`.

custom_form.description: The form Acme Pty Ltd uses for new accounts
The form Acme Pty Ltd uses for new accounts

is_system_template.description: Whether the form is system generated. A system generated form cannot be deleted.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can be stale on the last page.
